children: 60 Degrees Pharmaceuticals submitted a request for a Commissioner’s National Priority Voucher to support an efficacy supplement to NDA 210607 for tafenoquine to treat babesiosis.
Submitted Statement of Interest to FDA on Sept 12, 2026 requesting a CNPV for an efficacy supplement to NDA 210607 for ARAKODA (tafenoquine).
Company cites compelling efficacy signal: published reports ~83% cure in relapsing patients; all 3 evaluable expanded-access patients cured.
Randomized double-blind trial NCT06207370 completed enrollment for interim analysis; DSMB review scheduled Oct 1, 2026.
Target sNDA submission planned for March–April 2027; CNPV could enable approval at or before 2027 tick season, accelerating access and payer/hospital adoption.
